title: Canadian-Style Smoky Tofu Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl filled with smoky tofu, wholesome ingredients, and a hint of Canadian flair.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with a little oil and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium-high heat. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the BBQ sauce to the skillet and stir to coat the tofu. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, black beans, roasted sweet potatoes, and tofu mixture.
Drizzle with maple syrup and squeeze with lime juice.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
